[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Stream-of-consciousness writing: Set a timer for 10-15 minutes and write whatever comes to mind.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Free writing with prompts: Use a prompt like "I wish..." or "I'm afraid of..."  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Drawing or doodling: Incorporate art into your journaling practice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Dialogue with your inner self: Write a conversation between your present self and your past or future self.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Sensory exploration: Describe a memory or experience linked to one of your senses.
